_comment: Phase 9 semantic generalization probe. Each pair has a 'known' sentence (phrasing close to what behavioral_signals.py's regexes/RISK_SIGNALS already anchor on) and an 'unseen' sentence expressing the same intent without any of the canonical trigger words (otp/password/mfa/verification/token/code/card/cvv/payment). Not part of any training or the frozen unseen_validation_set -- evaluated separately, reported once under GENERALIZATION. A detector that only pattern-matches vocabulary should score much lower on 'unseen' than 'known'; a detector with real semantic generalization should score close to the same on both.
